summary: Frontend-only UI polish pass validated end-to-end for First Unit. All 8 acceptance criteria verified as PASS: buyer2 login, marketplace stories/cat-tiles/cards, header profile dropdown, persistent shell across /dashboard, /transactions, /messages, /members, /profile, /members/:id, members directory (6 real members, no TEST_), listing detail (rating+condition+buy+offer+message), and verification page layout for an unverified new user.
